canonical_project: National Data Processing Center (Digital Economy Concept 2026-2028 / State Programme)
owner: Government of Turkmenistan (Ministry of Communications / TÜRKMENARAGATNAŞYK agency) with UNDP AI-strategy support
notes: Policy/plan-level single facility lead, priority bucket Ashgabat per methodology. Official 2018-2022 releases used 'planned / necessary to open / steps are being taken' language (turkmenistan.gov.tm post 63237 names a single Information Center/Data Center; TDH post 19534; gov.tm post 13270 president calling for a National Data Centre). News Central Asia (2026-05-26) reports the October 2025 'Concept for the Development of the Digital Economy for 2026-2028' and January 2026 State Programme include a national data processing center, National AI Development Center and cloud infrastructure. NO opened/commissioned evidence found this pass - stays planned; do not count e-gov portal (e.gov.tm) existence as a built data center.
